errors.evidence: Description does not mention that the y-axis includes a dashed line representing the baseline of '4×tokens,4-bit'.
Description states that 'LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit' shows a decline to approximately -5% at layers 5-12, but actual data shows a decline to about -10%.

'Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit' is incorrectly referred to as a solid line in the description, when it is actually a dashed line.
